case_name: Two-cycle shallow-marine profile with differential subsidence
scientific_role: Deterministic process-model and methods demonstration; not independent validation against a real geological system
interpretation_limits: This is a deterministic process-model demonstration, not field validation.
A positive layer-matrix entry is a net surface increment, not proof that an original depositional layer survived.
The net-positive increment fraction is not stratigraphic completeness.
Subsidence, compaction and erosion prevent direct conversion of positive entries into represented time.
